title: Napoleon's Letter
subtitle: A Feather, A Thief, and a Hidden Puzzle
summary: When a young boy’s beloved bird vanishes from its cage, the famed detective Feluda is drawn into a deceptively simple case that soon reveals deeper mysteries. With only a single feather as a clue, Feluda must untangle a web of secrets that promises to challenge even his brilliant mind. Step into a world where nothing is quite as it seems, and every detail could be the key to the truth.
